IN THE FILTER PICKER                                                                                
j/k ↑↓  pick                                                                                        
Enter   add the chip                                                                                
type    narrow the choices                                                                          
Esc     back                                                                                        
fields  s state, t type, p priority, g group, l tag, a assignee, e epic                             
                                                                                                    
EVERYWHERE                                                                                          
?       this help, from anywhere; / finds in it                                                     
ctrl-c  quit

== sort ? at 100x30
HUG · help   60/60 tasks · ! 2 broken · 35 advice                                                   
view: overview  list  board  !lint             │ todo 8 · doing 15 (1 depends) · depends 7 · done 15
filter: none · sort: rank                                                                           
IN THE SORT PICKER                                                                                  
j/k ↑↓     pick                                                                                     
Space      add the picked field, again flips it                                                     
letter     add a field (then by), again flips it                                                    
r          rank: the default board order, at once; clears every field                               
c          the marked column, as o: again flips, then off                                           
fields     p priority, t type, s state, u updated, d created, g group, a assignee, n title          
Backspace  remove the last field                                                                    
Enter      add the picked field after j/k, else apply the order                                     
Esc        keep the order as it was                                                                 
                                                                                                    
EVERYWHERE                                                                                          
?       this help, from anywhere; / finds in it                                                     
ctrl-c  quit                                                                                        
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
                                                                                                    
All tasks · : filters and commands · ! lint finding · ↳ epic · depends = a dependency is not done   
                                                                                                    
/ find · j/k scroll · </> ends · PgUp/PgDn page · Esc back · ? close
